name: Gearbox
text: Deploy the AMD MI325X cluster running Llama 4 70B as EXCAVA’s primary engine. It’s the fastest open-weight model we can run in-house right now, cutting inference latency by 30% over the current stack. The trade-off is higher power draw and cooling load, but the net gain in throughput outweighs the cost.

name: Torque
text: Locking into AMD MI325X risks a single-vendor death spiral—if AMD shifts pricing, drops support, or exits the AI chip market, EXCAVA’s primary engine becomes a stranded asset. A safer play is to dual-run Llama 4 70B on MI325X *and* a secondary stack (e.g., NVIDIA H100 with vLLM) for 6 months; if the AMD cluster’s 30% latency cut holds without stability issues, migrate fully—otherwise, the fallback keeps us unblocked. Settle it with a 30-day bake-off measuring throughput, power cost per token, and failure rates under load.
